args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ws='${workspaceFolder}'; $src='${file}'; $bin=Join-Path $ws 'bin'; if (!(Test-Path $bin)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bin | Out-Null }; $cobc=(Get-Command cobc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (-not $cobc) { throw 'cobc not found in PATH. Install GnuCOBOL and restart VS Code.' }; $out=Join-Path $bin '${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe'; & $cobc.Source -x -o $out $src

tasks.label: COBOL: Compile all files
args: source '${workspaceFolder}/setup_cobol_env.sh' && mkdir -p '${workspaceFolder}/bin' && shopt -s nullglob && for f in '${workspaceFolder}'/*.cbl '${workspaceFolder}'/*.CBL; do name=$(basename "$f"); out="${name%.*}"; "$COBC" -x -o '${workspaceFolder}/bin/'"$out" "$f"; done

$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ws='${workspaceFolder}'; $bin=Join-Path $ws 'bin'; if (!(Test-Path $bin)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $bin | Out-Null }; $cobc=(Get-Command cobc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (-not $cobc) { throw 'cobc not found in PATH. Install GnuCOBOL and restart VS Code.' }; $files=Get-ChildItem -Path $ws -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.cbl','.CBL' }; foreach ($f in $files) { $out=Join-Path $bin ($f.BaseName + '.exe'); & $cobc.Source -x -o $out $f.FullName }
